name: Chariot
summary: Adelaide ISP; built through acquisition: SA roll-up (OurWorld 1998; Cobweb, Newave, InterNex, Satlink, Pipeline, Box, Ompac, CNN, Universal; Picknowl 2002; Mr Bean, Better.Net, eCITE, Cyberwizards Mar 2003; Blue Pin/Northnet + Squirrel Net Aug 2003; Ledanet + Broadnet 11 May 2004) and a Queensland consolidation into the 'Chariot netconnect' brand (Qld Net, Technet 2000, Mackay Internet, Oznetcom by Mar 2005). FY2003-04 alone: 10 ISP acquisitions, ~32,000 customers. TPG took a controlling stake Feb 2007 and the Chariot brand then ran on as a TPG-Soul/TPG retail ISP (dialup + ADSL/ADSL2+ + webmail) for over a decade, its site live to ~2023 (CHARIOT LIMITED, ACN 088 377 860).

events.details: Little Adelaide dialup ISP; General Manager John Lindsay (1997-1999) built it into an ASX-listed company (CTI).
Acquired OurWorld Global Network's customer base (incl. ex-iiNet SA customers) from the liquidator; John Lindsay, GM 1997-1999, was previously GM of OGN.

Not folded c.2010: after TPG-Soul took full ownership (Feb 2009 site notes 'Chariot is now wholly owned by the TPG-Soul Group'), Chariot ran on as a live TPG retail ISP brand (dialup/ADSL/ADSL2+/webmail; 'Chariot Internet Ltd', 'Chariot Ltd trading as Picknowl') well into 2019. chariot.net.au served a maintained site through Jan 2023, then became a permanent 301 redirect from 2024, marking the brand's retirement.
